candidates.statement: A. Invitations for Center staff to participate in outside events should be forwarded to DMAT.
candidates.context: B. DMAT will review, record, track the request, and make recommendations to the appropriate Office/Division Director with regard to CBER staff participation.

candidates.statement: 2. Informs the event sponsors of CBER’s expectations: • Sponsors should submit a formal request for staff participation in an event • Requests should include the name(s) of speaker(s) (if known) and topic/subject matter; event date, title and location; meeting agenda (if available); anticipated attendance; and targeted audience.
candidates.context: 1. Serves as the CBER contact point and processes all requests for CBER participation in outside events. • Requests should be submitted as early as possible in the planning process.

candidates.statement: • Requests should be submitted as early as possible in the planning process.
